question: Using only the data from the ‘results’ table, find the three years in which the sum of the highest total points earned by any driver and the highest total points earned by any constructor in that year (both calculated by summing up points from the ‘results’ table) is smallest, and list those three years in order of ascending total.
sql:
WITH year_driver_max AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MAX(driver_points) as max_driver_points
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ra.year,
            SUM(res.points) as driver_points
        FROM results res
        JOIN races ra ON res.race_id = ra.race_id
        GROUP BY ra.year, res.driver_id
    ) driver_totals
    GROUP BY year
),
year_constructor_max AS (
    SELECT 
        year,
        MAX(constructor_points) as max_constructor_points
    FROM (
        SELECT 
            ra.year,
            SUM(res.points) as constructor_points
        FROM results res
        JOIN races ra ON res.race_id = ra.race_id
        GROUP BY ra.year, res.constructor_id
    ) constructor_totals
    GROUP BY year
)
SELECT 
    ydm.year
FROM year_driver_max ydm
JOIN year_constructor_max ycm ON ydm.year = ycm.year
ORDER BY ydm.max_driver_points + ycm.max_constructor_points ASC
LIMIT 3
